value: Langmuir fitted slightly better, indicating monolayer adsorption on a homogeneous surface.
quote: This illustrated that adsorption of SMX and ACM on GNP C300 was monolayer adsorption occurring on a homogenous surface without interaction between the adsorbate.

value: Pseudo-second-order kinetics fitted better, taken as chemisorption.
quote: It is proved that the adsorption of SMX and ACM using GNP C300 was owing to chemisorption as the data were best fitted with pseudo-second order.

value: Docking gave negative binding energies, meaning spontaneous binding.
quote: The binding energies for both molecules were negative values; −7.54 kcal mol −1 and −5.29 kcal mol −1 for SMX and ACM, respectively, which means the SMX and ACM were bound spontaneously to the surface of GNP C300 without consuming energy.

value: Adsorption lowered the BET surface area of C300.
quote: This shows adsorption had occurred as the SMX molecules adhered to the surface of GNP C300 thus resulting in a notably lower surface area, micropore area and external surface area.

value: 5% ethanol-deionized water was the suitable eluent for regeneration.
quote: Conclusively, regeneration of the GNP C300 by 5% ethanol-deionized water was considered the suitable eluent for both pollutants, SMX and ACM with high removal efficiencies after several adsorption–desorption cycles.

value: C300 removed over 98% of SMX and over 90% of ACM from real water samples.
quote: More than 98% of SMX were removed from all three real water samples: Langat river water, Kuyoh river water and tap water, while for ACM the removal efficiency was somewhat lower than SMX yet more than 90%.
